class.name: DrapeClothModifier3D
class.brief_description: A position-based cloth solve over chains of bones hanging side by side.
class.description: Moves chains of bones that hang side by side around a body, as a skirt's columns do, as one piece of cloth. Each chain's joints are particles, the top of each chain pinned where the pose put it, with a tip past each chain's last bone. Links run down each chain (held to their length), round each ring of joints and diagonally to the ring above (held from stretching, free to gather), and capsules on the skeleton's bones push out the particles and every link between them. Each joint is drawn toward its hang in the incoming pose, by [member top_pull] at the top fading to [member hem_pull] at the bottom; gravity has the rest. The solve runs in the center bone's frame, so the skeleton's travel does not swing it. The layout is given by [method set_layout] and the capsules by [method set_colliders]. It skips the physics tick's pass unless the tree is paused, and holds the last solve on a pass with no elapsed time.

method.name: clear_layout
method.description: Removes the layout; the modifier then does nothing.

method.name: get_particles
method.description: Every particle's place after the last solve, in the center bone's frame.

method.name: get_resets
method.description: How many times a pose jumping more than [member snap_distance] has started the cloth over.

method.name: reset
method.description: Starts the cloth over from the next pass's pose.

method.name: set_colliders
method.description: Per capsule: the bone it is on, its axis's two ends in that bone's frame (two entries per capsule in [param ends]), and its radius at each end.

method.name: set_layout
method.description: The particles, chain by chain from top to tip: per particle its bone ([code]-1[/code] for a tip past the bone before it), the particle above it ([code]-1[/code] for a chain's pinned top, otherwise the particle listed before it), and a tip's length. [param links] has three ints per link: its two particles and its [enum LinkKind]. Link lengths are measured from the bones' rests on the first pass.

members.member: The share of each particle's velocity lost each pass.
Gravity's acceleration, downward in the skeleton's space.
Per pass, the share of the way the deepest joints are drawn toward their hang in the pose.
How many times each pass the links and capsules are satisfied in turn.
If [code]true[/code], a particle or link a pass carried across a capsule's axis is put back out on the side it started the pass on, not through the capsule's far side.
Above 0, the furthest a particle's own motion and its pull toward the hang take it in a second, past how far its hang moved. The capsules' push is not limited.
The share of a stretched ring link's excess taken out each iteration.
The share of a stretched diagonal link's excess taken out each iteration.

A joint just below a pinned top moving more than this in one pass, in the center bone's frame (a pose restored, a cut in the animation), starts the cloth over from the pose. The joints further down are not watched: a stride may swing them that far.
Per pass, the share of the way the first joints below the pinned tops are drawn toward their hang in the pose.

constants.constant: A link down a chain, held to its length.
A link between neighbouring chains at one depth, held from stretching.
A link from a joint to its neighbour's joint above, held from stretching.
